contract.question: Does the canonical regular local interaction's joint first-Q activation transmit into the original moving-root U, and can that transmission be reduced to adjacent-site contacts?
contract.model: At each original vacant vertex use T0+epsilon*Kreg/N, Kreg=average_C4 i(I-P1)i^dagger. The occupied summand and original q/E are unchanged. c(Q)=1 identically, not fitted.
contract.primary_quantity: J2=d_logQ d_epsilon^2 U at Q1,epsilon0, for the original N25 paired-geometry pooled-root observer.
contract.joint_source: s2(A)=2/N^2 sum_{unordered distinct vacant x,y} g_xy(A), where g_xy is the first Q derivative of the actual relative joint colour contraction. The 2 is the second derivative of epsilon^2. No same-site term exists because each local tensor is linear in epsilon.
contract.translation_reduction: Against every translation-invariant K/q/E observable and thermal derivative, s2 can be counted as (1/N) sum_{y!=origin} g_origin,y. Do not multiply by two again.
contract.kernel: Reuse the committed Bell8 signed g16=16*g lookup, SHA256 36ae069d370b1d7a4398861c928afb41aa76885c8895c696b1bc0c97e9c314fd. Missing valid canonical keys are exact zero. Ports x:N,E,S,W,y:N,E,S,W.
contract.physical_components: For two vacant marks, occupied neighbours use original black NN DSU roots; vacant-neighbour incident edges use unique undirected physical-edge identifiers. Adjacent marks share one such edge and must share its singleton label. Keep original rank/q/E; inserted virtual wiring never changes their assignment.
theory_gates: Prove the all-pair first-Q source equals the full J2 linear original-U response, including root movement and thermal slope terms; no products of separately closed marks substitute for joint kernels.
Prove the same Bell8 normalized colour contraction applies to adjacent marks with their shared physical edge identified, or stop before sampling a changed kernel.
contract.fixed_decomposition: Partition pairs before production into adjacent original NN pairs and all remaining distinct-site pairs. Retain total=adjacent+nonadjacent and all three source/q-source/E-source moments. No radius, angular or support subclasses will be selected after readout.
contract.integer_source: b16=sum_{y!=origin} g16(origin,y). Divide each new accumulated moment by 16*N=400 exactly once. Origin-occupied configurations contribute zero source but remain in the full population.
contract.baseline: Import root_enclosure, matching_slope_enclosure and U25_over_A_enclosure from results/p337-closed-source-n25/latest.json. Reuse locked q/E marginals. No root solve or old-source score.
contract.primary_prediction: Every model with a configurationwise additive first-Q effective log weight that is linear in epsilon predicts J2_total=0. A strictly signed exact rational enclosure excludes this global closure on the fixed pair.
contract.secondary_prediction: A claim that the joint first-Q interaction contributes to original U only through adjacent-site contacts predicts J2_nonadjacent=0. A nonzero prescribed nonadjacent response excludes this contact-only global closure at N25; it is not a continuum long-distance limit.
contract.canonical_prediction_boundary: No unconditional sign for canonical total, adjacent or nonadjacent J2 is claimed before calculation. Positivity of one conditional Gram contraction does not fix the global root/slope response sign.
contract.score: One exact rational readout of total and its two fixed linear contributions, retaining all covariance centering, thermal derivatives, pooled-root and slope terms. If a rational enclosure includes zero, that quantity is unresolved at the fixed precision. No source, completion, geometry or precision rescue follows.
contract.production: One complete 2^25 traversal per geometry solely for missing joint crossmoments, after accepted theory and producer commits. Local two-worker CPU computation; no stochastic sampling or cloud startup is needed.
contract.dependency: The same complete exact N25 occupation populations as the earlier first-source results, with newly specified joint contractions. This is a new model response, not independent stochastic confirmation. Total/adjacent/nonadjacent are one dependency group per geometry.
